structure.summary: County Republican central committees, elected on the gubernatorial primary ballot for 4-year terms, countywide or by district. The state party constitution sets each committee's size (at least 5); state law overrides it in some counties. Next election: the 2030 gubernatorial primary.
structure.seat_data_source: Maryland State Board of Elections county primary results

notes: Structure only. Seat-by-seat status has not been collected.
